title: 雨天裡的溫暖小幫手
logline: 男孩在雨天幫助迷路的小貓找到回家的路。
art_style: children's picture book, gouache illustration, flat bold colors

characters.name: 小傑
characters.appearance: young boy, short brown hair, blue raincoat, yellow rain boots, small backpack
characters.personality: 善良又勇敢，樂於幫助別人

characters.name: 小貓
characters.appearance: small gray kitten, big eyes, white paws
characters.personality: 害怕又迷路，渴望找到溫暖家

panels.scene: 下著細雨，小傑在街上撐著藍色雨傘走路。
panels.image_prompt: boy holding blue umbrella walking on wet street with raindrops, gentle expression, cloudy light

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 小傑撐著傘走在下雨的街上。

panels.scene: 小傑發現一隻淋濕又害怕的小貓躲在街角。
panels.image_prompt: boy spotting frightened kitten hiding in wet street corner, concerned look

dialogue.speaker: boy
dialogue.text: 小貓，你怎麼一個人在這裡？

panels.scene: 小傑蹲下，用雨傘遮住小貓，輕輕地摸牠。
panels.image_prompt: boy crouching shielding kitten with umbrella, kitten looking relieved, soft warm light

panels.scene: 小傑抱著小貓，沿著街道尋找牠的家。
panels.image_prompt: boy carrying kitten walking carefully on rainy street, looking around for clues

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 小傑帶著小貓一起找牠的家。

panels.scene: 他們來到一戶人家門口，小貓快樂地叫著。
panels.image_prompt: boy standing by house door, kitten excitedly meowing, soft evening light

panels.scene: 小傑和小貓揮手道別，小貓安全回家了。
panels.image_prompt: boy waving goodbye to kitten at doorstep, kitten looking happy inside, warm light

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 小傑開心地看著小貓回家了。
